headline: Contoh Foods: a second line inside the Klang plant more than doubled daily output
intro: Contoh Foods added capacity without a new building. It upgraded lines, moved to one ERP system and retrained operators to run more than one machine.
email_intro: Contoh Foods added capacity without a new building. A second line, one ERP system and multi-skilled operators did most of the work.

dtf.analysis: Value added per employee rose 18% between FY2022 and FY2026. The steepest rise came in FY2025, the year the second Klang line started. Fixed-asset productivity rose least, so new equipment is still bedding in.

lessons.label: Lesson 1 · New/upgraded line
lessons.title: Add a second line inside your plant before you build a new one
lessons.did: Contoh Foods installed a second filling line at Klang in FY2025. Output rose from 70,000 to 180,000 packs a day.
lessons.did_short: A second Klang line took output from 70,000 to 180,000 packs a day.
lessons.sme: Look for floor space you already pay for. A refurbished second-hand line can suit firms with 50–200 staff.
lessons.starter: Measure one week of output per hour on your busiest line and note every stoppage.
lessons.measure: Output per line-hour, before and after.

lessons.label: Lesson 2 · Workforce/skills
lessons.title: Train each operator to run two machines
lessons.did: Contoh Foods trained 120 operators on a second machine. Rework hours fell 12.4%.
lessons.did_short: 120 operators trained on a second machine; rework hours fell 12.4%.
lessons.sme: Pick your two most common machines and pair operators for cross-training on quiet shifts.
lessons.starter: List who can run which machine on one sheet this week.

lessons.label: Lesson 3 · Automation/digital
lessons.title: Put orders, stock and production on one system
lessons.did: Contoh Foods moved three plants to one ERP system in FY2026, cutting month-end stock counts from five days to two.
lessons.did_short: One ERP system cut stock counts from five days to two.
lessons.sme: Start with a cloud stock system linked to sales orders before full ERP.
lessons.starter: Time your next stock count from start to finish.
lessons.measure: Days to close a stock count.

notes: Sources: Contoh Foods Berhad Annual Report FY2026 and Sustainability Report FY2026. Figures as reported, not independently audited. Value added is an analyst proxy. Not investment advice.
